item.title: Galesburg-area factory closing, laying off 160 workers
item.description: A manufacturing plant near Galesburg is shutting down next month, costing 160 employees their jobs, a document from the Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity shows.

item.title: Registration open for Gran Fondo benefiting Mary Free Bed
item.description: Registration for the popular Gran Fondo ride opened this week.

item.title: GR Public Museum: Carousel reopening just one step of riverfront development
item.description: The newly restored carousel at the Grand Rapids Public Museum officially opened Friday morning. The reopening of the nearly 100-year-old carousel is just one step in growing the attractions along the Grand River.

item.title: 'Quad God' Ilia Malinin falls twice in Olympic disaster, allowing Mikhail Shaidorov to claim gold
item.description: MILAN (AP) — American figure skating sensation Ilia Malinin fell twice in a disastrous free skate that sent him tumbling all the way off the podium at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Friday night, allowing Mikhail Shaidorov to Kazakhstan to claim a stunning gold medal. item.title: Old Skool Bar opens in Kalamazoo
item.description: A new bar with a retro vibe is celebrating its grand opening in Kalamazoo this weekend.

item.title: Man sentenced in GRPD Vice Unit's 'largest ever' fentanyl bust
item.description: A man will spend at least four years in prison for what the Grand Rapids Police Department Vice Unit called its largest fentanyl bust its ever made.

item.title: Search and rescue expert weighs in on Lake Odessa teen disappearance
item.description: In the search for Devlin Tait, investigators are asking people in Ionia, Barry and Eaton Counties to keep their eyes open for anything that might be connected to his disappearance.

item.title: MSU holds Day of Remembrance three years after deadly mass shooting
item.description: Friday marks three years since a shooting at Michigan State University that killed three students and injured five others. The university cancelled most classes giving the Spartan community the space to reflect and honor those impacted by the shooting.

item.title: Firefighters suffer minor injuries during apartment fire in Zeeland
item.description: An apartment building in Zeeland caught fire Friday afternoon, police say.

item.title: ‘Powerless’: Muskegon mom concerned about community safety
item.description: After gunshots were fired outside her Muskegon home, a woman decided to take her fear and frustration to city leaders as a call for help.
